description.zh: 您的阿里云账号（主账号）ID。
description.en: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account.

description.zh: API调用时间，格式为**EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT**。
description.en: The time when the operation is called. The format is: **EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT**.
The trace ID of the request for Function Compute API.

description.zh: 层的名称。仅支持查询自定义层版本，不支持查询官方公共层版本。
description.en: The layer name. You can query only custom layer versions. You cannot query versions of official public layers.

description.zh: 限定此次返回资源的数量。如果不设定，默认返回20，最大不能超过100。返回结果可以小于指定的数量，但不会多于指定的数量。
description.en: The maximum number of resources to return. Default value: 20. The value cannot exceed 100. The number of returned configurations is less than or equal to the specified number.
The initial version of the layer.
